addition:
## Acquired fulfillment governs further inquiry

The [new native continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md) acquires consequences into a compact phase table and uses them to determine whether another unresolved phase is investigated. The actual productive event both replenishes operating support and fulfills the already specified productive-use component. Its consequence can then be acquired, retained and read, allowing the changed situation to govern further inquiry. These are differently accessible relations within one unfolding; the physical effect may occur even when its receipt cannot subsequently be acquired.

With faithful contact, a positive at the second phase ends this episode while the third phase remains unknown. A matched intervention preserves the same acquired result, table and completion-reading expenditure but disconnects its influence on stopping. It investigates the third phase. In one world that consumes the remaining packet without benefit; in another it supplies an additional productive return. The result establishes an operative, episode-relative response to acquired fulfillment, not the universal superiority of stopping or complete knowledge as a prerequisite for action.

[Fifteen prospective histories and independent reconstruction](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/INQUIRY.md) retain the original endowment, H110 and acquisition schedule. A false positive causes reported completion without a productive effect; a false negative prolongs inquiry after actual fulfillment. In the wholly unproductive world, the last extraction leaves insufficient support to acquire its negative receipt. The table remains incomplete; an external audit cannot silently supply the missing acquired record. This statement concerns the implemented table/contact route, not everything a different reader might infer from resource changes or denial signals.

The productive-use component and completion/inquiry recipe remain supplied locally. Their place in this model does not make them external to generative reality, but the construction does not explain their formation. It is an alternative continuation of the preceding acquired-model history, not the preceding refinement and this study executed in sequence. The remaining connection is acquired understanding of which ongoing dependency survives component completion and how that relation warrants revising the broader undertaking. A further requirement does not undo the completed historical event; correcting a false completion belief is a different change. Existing inquiry-limit and method revision remain credited; merely adding another fixed goal switch would not close the explanation. The [whole-process ethical account](UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#the-whole-as-the-grounding-question) continues to govern questions of affected lives and shared conditions beyond this synthetic support law.
